environment.type: local deterministic reference and synthetic cross-domain pilot
environment.validation: jsonschema 4.26.0 and PyYAML 6.0.3 in isolated environment

inputs: explicit IEPE source and immutable revision

evaluations.result: identical inputs produce identical generated files
existing files are preserved without explicit overwrite and existing-project discovery preserves all inspected bytes
project profile, package source, and compiled manifest retain the same IEPE identity, source, version, and revision
a synthetic design project generated six validated process skills and an explicit read-only first-cycle prompt
16 schemas, 8 issue templates, 6 process skills, 14 evidence bundles, 16 example records, domain neutrality, and 46 reference tests pass

baselineComparison.before: initialization and command surfaces were documented but adopters had to assemble their own project-local operating layer
baselineComparison.after: one command creates a reference-pinned, skill-equipped, package-ready project without claiming unresolved local authority

tradeoffs: the bootstrap projects procedural skill copies into the adopter while retaining upstream protocol authority
greenfield defaults are explicitly provisional and require local confirmation before work becomes Ready
limitations: the initializer records but does not cryptographically resolve or attest the supplied upstream revision
existing-project mode inventories but does not generate or apply a migration overlay
no live GitHub adapter or unrelated external project has completed the full IEPE trace
reproduction: Install requirements-dev.txt in an isolated environment, run python3 tools/validate.py, then run tools/init_project.py new and compile the generated .agents/package-source.json.
